title: Day 30: Your 30-Day Action Plan – Whether Buying or Selling
excerpt: A four-week plan for Austin buyers and sellers—what to do first, and what can wait.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “steps to sell house Austin”, “home buying checklist 2026 Texas”, and “what to do first buy or sell Austin” want a local, practical answer.

If selling: Week 1 – Interview agents, order CMA and pre-listing inspection. Week 2 – Complete high-ROI repairs and declutter.

Week 3 – Professional photos, finalize pricing and marketing plan. Week 4 – List, monitor feedback, and be ready to adjust.

If buying: Week 1 – Full pre-approval and agent interviews. Week 2 – Define must-haves and tour target areas.

Week 3–4 – Refine criteria, watch new listings and reductions daily, write clean offers when the right home appears.

In both cases: stay data-driven, communicate quickly, and treat the process as a project with clear milestones. The 2026 Central Texas market rewards preparation over timing perfection.
